name: Voice of the Customer
description: Customer-perception measurement system: survey instruments, unsolicited listening posts, driver analysis linking perception to operational causes, and close-the-loop workflows that act on individual negative experiences.
roleInCenter: Outcome judge: the only system measuring whether the rest of the center felt good to the customer.

glossary.definition: Any structured channel capturing customer perception, solicited or not
Net Promoter Score: promoters minus detractors from 0-10 recommendation question
Customer satisfaction rating on the interaction just completed
Customer effort score; best predictor for loyalty in service contexts
Free-text response; richest driver material when text-mined
Response quality and rate degrading when over-surveyed by channel or journey
Statistical link from operational metrics and root causes to perception outcomes
Workflow contacting unhappy respondents to resolve their issue and capture recovery learning

children.name: Relationship Survey
children.description: Periodic brand-level health survey, not contact-tied

children.name: Employee Insight Roundtrip
children.description: Frontline hypotheses about customer pain validated against VOC data

children.name: Custom Journey Instrument
children.description: Questions tied to a specific journey stage in the engine journey map

metrics.name: Net Promoter Score
metrics.definition: Promoters minus detractors as share of respondents

metrics.name: Customer Effort Score
metrics.definition: Mean effort rating; effort drives disloyalty more than delight

metrics.name: Survey Response Rate
metrics.definition: Completed surveys per offered survey; sudden shifts signal fatigue or sampling change

metrics.name: Close-the-Loop Rate
metrics.definition: Share of high-severity negative respondents contacted within SLA

metrics.name: Repeat-Driver Share
metrics.definition: Share of negative verbatims repeating the same top driver period over period

failureModes.name: CSAT Theater
failureModes.signal: Survey scores up while retention and churn signals flat or worse
failureModes.mitigation: Track NPS/CES alongside; disallow survey gating in agent scripts

failureModes.name: Survey Gaming
failureModes.signal: Score clustering at maximum with response times under 5 seconds on one team
failureModes.mitigation: Fraud filters on response velocity; QA cross-check verbatims for agent prompting

failureModes.name: Unactioned Drivers
failureModes.signal: Same top-3 driver verbatims every quarter with no linked backlog items
failureModes.mitigation: Driver themes must open KM/QA/routing backlog items with owners

failureModes.name: Sampling Bias
failureModes.signal: Respondents skew to extreme experiences; mid-experience voice missing
failureModes.mitigation: Quota sampling across journey stages and sentiment strata

scoringModel.name: VOC Signal Fidelity & Closed-Loop Recovery Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Scores Voice of the Customer program execution on statistical de-biasing, multi-signal perception fusion, root-cause driver attribution, and timely close-the-loop detractor recovery.

dimensions.name: Sampling Integrity & Non-Response De-Biasing
dimensions.description: Stratified invitation governance, fatigue throttling, and inverse-propensity weighting to eliminate extreme-experience survivorship bias
sampleCriteria: Zero agent-controlled survey gating or selective invitation suppression
Fatigue quarantine enforced per customer across channels and journey stages
Direct survey scores fused with unsolicited behavioral and sentiment proxies

dimensions.name: Root-Cause Driver Attribution Precision
dimensions.description: Causal linkage from verbatim themes and operational telemetry (AHT, transfers, hold time, policy friction) to CSAT, CES, and NPS shifts
sampleCriteria: Verbatims automatically decomposed into structured operational root causes
Driver elasticity quantified against FCR, effort, and repeat contact rates
Top negative drivers linked directly to owned KM, QA, or routing backlog items

dimensions.name: Closed-Loop Detractor Recovery Execution
dimensions.description: Speed, empathy, and resolution completeness of follow-up workflows triggered by high-severity detractor responses
sampleCriteria: High-severity detractors contacted within 24-hour close-the-loop SLA
Underlying customer issue resolved rather than merely acknowledged
Recovery outcome and systemic fix logged back to CRM and VOC ledger

dimensions.name: Continuous Journey & Model Calibration
dimensions.description: Ongoing alignment between inferred interaction sentiment and post-contact survey truth across customer segments
sampleCriteria: Latent satisfaction model recalibrated weekly against completed CSAT and CES
CSAT-theater divergence between survey scores and churn flagged automatically
Frontline Voice of the Employee insights corroborated against VOC trends

exchanges: Interaction mining as unsolicited listening posts
Verbatim topic models shared for driver analysis
Survey trigger keyed to case and contact
Evaluation outcomes correlated with transactional surveys
Low-score contacts feed targeted QA sampling
Close-the-loop callbacks as compliant service outreach
Driver themes missing answers open content backlog

stateVariables.description: Continuous latent customer satisfaction state fusing sparse post-contact survey posteriors with dense real-time behavioral effort and acoustic-textual sentiment proxies
Observation selection probability modeling survey completion propensity as a function of interaction intensity and survey fatigue to correct non-response survivorship bias
Instantaneous customer defection and relationship attrition hazard driven by cumulative unresolved effort friction and detractor state
Time-varying partial derivative vector quantifying the marginal impact of K operational friction drivers (hold time, transfers, policy denials, repeat touches) on S_voc(t)
Cumulative solicitation fatigue state that depresses response propensity pi_resp(x, t) when customers are over-sampled across channels

differentialEquations.name: Survivorship-Corrected Latent Satisfaction Filtering SDE
differentialEquations.formula: dS_voc(t) = -lambda_decay * (S_voc(t) - S_base) * dt - beta_drv(t)^T * dPhi_friction(t) + K_kalman * pi_resp(x, t)^(-1) * (Y_surv(t) - S_voc(t)) * dN_obs(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Continuously evolves latent satisfaction S_voc(t) under operational friction impulses dPhi_friction(t) while applying inverse-propensity-weighted Kalman updates pi_resp(x, t)^(-1) whenever a sparse survey response dN_obs(t) arrives, eliminating non-response survivorship bias

differentialEquations.name: Detractor Churn Hazard & Closed-Loop Recovery Dynamics
differentialEquations.formula: dh_churn(t) * inv(dt) = alpha_det * max(0, S_crit - S_voc(t))^2 + gamma_effort * CES_latent(t) - mu_ctl * u_recovery(t) * h_churn(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Models the quadratic surge in churn hazard h_churn(t) when latent satisfaction drops below the detractor threshold S_crit or effort CES_latent(t) spikes, and quantifies hazard damping achieved by timely close-the-loop recovery interventions u_recovery(t)

differentialEquations.name: Continuous Operational Driver Attribution Elasticity Equation
differentialEquations.formula: beta_drv_k(t) = -grad_Phi_k E[ S_voc(t) | Phi_friction(t) ] = Cov_local( dS_voc(t), dPhi_k(t) ) * inv( Var_local( dPhi_k(t) ) )
differentialEquations.interpretation: Computes the exact instantaneous elasticity of customer perception with respect to each operational driver k, ranking root-cause fixes by their true marginal lift on S_voc(t)

scaleInvariants: Horvitz-Thompson de-biasing invariant: inverse-propensity weighting pi_resp(x, t)^(-1) yields an unbiased estimator of population satisfaction across 100% of contacts even when survey response rates are below 5%
Closed-loop Lyapunov stability: executing recovery action u_recovery(t) within the golden SLA window guarantees negative churn-hazard drift dh_churn(t) * inv(dt) < 0
Driver conservation identity: sum of attributed driver elasticities plus unmodeled residual equals total observed variance in latent satisfaction S_voc(t)
